activity_statements.statement: operates a nationwide wireless network serving 120 million mobility subscribers (91M postpaid including 74M phone subscribers) under AT&T, Cricket, and AT&T PREPAID brands
provides fiber broadband to 14.7 million US customers (10.4 million on fiber, 1.5 million on AT&T Internet Air 5G fixed wireless) as part of Consumer Wireline segment

provides enterprise connectivity including fiber ethernet, dedicated internet, fixed wireless, IP voice, and managed professional services to multinational corporations, SMBs, and government customers through Business Wireline
operates FirstNet, the dedicated wireless network for first responders across the United States
provides wireless service in Mexico to approximately 24.7 million subscribers under AT&T and Unefon brands through Latin America segment
transitions legacy copper-based voice and data infrastructure to software-defined network (SDN) and fiber-based services

name_reality_gap: none - AT&T accurately signals telecommunications. However, the 'Telecommunications' label undersells the scale of the enterprise IT services and managed connectivity business; a significant workforce operates as enterprise IT professionals.
extraction_notes: 10-K Annual Report 2025 via Exa provided detailed segment data including subscriber counts, revenue percentages, and business unit descriptions. att.com/about returned product marketing content only. Excellent sourcing from 10-K.
